title: Extend the interoperability definition to workflow and pragmatic levels
requirements:
- Add a concise definition of interoperability at the start of 3.6
- State that context, provenance, time, certainty and units also carry meaning
- Add organisational and workflow interoperability to the interoperability levels
- Include process/workflow interoperability explicitly or define it within organisational interoperability
- Add pragmatic interoperability, anchored in the Health Information Exchange definition
- Replace 'clinically meaningful' with purpose-neutral wording covering non-clinical exchanges
- Make the blood-pressure example complete (units, method, position, timing)
- Address whether received information is understood and acted on at the point of care
